name: Hero Snow Water
description: A hero section with snow falling through the sky and water below, where the headline's last line stands on the waterline above its wavering reflection.

props.name: title
props.description: The headline, one string per line. Whatever line the text wraps to last stands with its baseline exactly on the waterline at every width; the whole headline is mirrored beneath it, wavering and fading with depth. On first view the earlier lines clear out of a blur and the last one rises out of the water, its reflection moving with it.

props.name: children
props.description: Supporting content: a paragraph and actions. It stands on the waterline beside the headline from 768px, and sits in the water below the reflection on narrower screens.

props.name: waterHeight
props.description: Depth of the water band under the waterline, in pixels or any CSS length.

props.name: snow
props.description: Snowflakes per 100,000 square pixels of sky. 0 turns the snow off.

props.name: as
props.description: The heading element for the headline.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the section, which is at least 36rem tall; the sky grows to fill any extra height. Other section props are passed through.
